title: Georgia early voting turnout
description: County-level counts of accepted early in-person and mail ballots for the current general election, with the mail pipeline and comparisons against past elections at the same point before election day.
updateCadence: Whenever the Secretary of State posts a new file, during early voting.
source: the Georgia Secretary of State; the county Census figures in early-vote/ come from the U.S. Census Bureau's American Community Survey, compiled by Georgia Civic Data (georgiacivicdata.org, CC BY 4.0)
